name: Alaska
about: Cruises, lodges and bear-viewing operate May–Sep, peaking Jun–Aug. Winter is a completely different trip built around aurora viewing.
overview: Glaciers calving into the sea, brown bears fishing for salmon, and the aurora overhead — one of the last truly wild frontiers in the US.
costOverview: Alaska runs expensive across the board — remoteness inflates even a basic seafood sandwich, and the marquee wildlife-viewing flights are a real splurge most visitors budget specifically for.

specialSeasons.text: This is peak bear-viewing season, timed to the salmon runs.
Long, dark nights make this aurora season — a completely different trip from summer's wildlife viewing.
